payout.formula: payout = stake * multiplierBps / 10000 if win else 0

jackpot.appliesWhen: receipt.params.jackpotArmed === true and outcome === EDGE and choice === EDGE: result.multiplierBps = EDGE_STREAK2 and result.edgeStreak = 2
jackpot.armedWhen: the player's previous coinflip38 action (nonce - 1, any stream) was a pure-cash EDGE bet that won at the base EDGE tier (result.edgeStreak = 1) under the same rulesVersion, and this bet is pure cash with choice EDGE. No stake condition.
jackpot.cashOnly: pure cash = REAL mode, no active bonus wager, zero bonus sats, not a free spin. KARMA and free-spin actions are never armed and never arm; they break the streak
jackpot.longRunFormula: RTP_EDGE = (19 * EDGE + EDGE_STREAK2) / 380 for constant-stake EDGE play; with stakes a (not armed) / b (armed): p*EDGE + p*(EDGE_STREAK2-EDGE)*min(a,b)/(19a+b) <= the constant-stake value
jackpot.payoutFormula: base = min(params.jackpotPrevStakeSats, params.stakeSats); payout = (EDGE * stakeSats + (EDGE_STREAK2 - EDGE) * base) / 10000 — the jackpot tier covers the arming stake, any stake above it pays EDGE
jackpot.resetAfter: a jackpot payout (result.edgeStreak = 2) resets the streak
